def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    a = parameters[0]
    b = parameters[1]
    c = parameters[2]
    d = parameters[3]
    e = parameters[4]
    f = parameters[5]
    g = parameters[6]
    h = parameters[7]
    i = parameters[8]
    j = parameters[9]
    k = parameters[10]
    l = parameters[11]
    
    gvgs = a + b*gate_voltage_abs + c*gate_voltage_abs**2 + d*gate_voltage_abs**3
    vds_breakpoint = e
    
    id = f * np.exp(gvgs) * np.heaviside(gate_voltage_abs - vds_breakpoint) \
        + h * np.heaviside(drain_voltage_abs - vds_breakpoint)
